source: #157 A-L1 host-cap recovery, second literal (RECOVERY-A-L1-MCP-HOSTCAP-R15): revision 14's entwurf_fresh_call MCP description fit the 2048-character host description cap but dropped four contract literals that test/fresh-call-surfaces.contract.test.ts asserts on the real bridge's tools/list ('entwurf_peers only reports', 'Model is REQUIRED', 'the CALLER', 'NOTHING is created'). Provenance, in this order and not to be blended with revision 14's: main wrote the complete new literal, restoring only those four expressions in revision 14's approved text, before any producer edit; Astra independently approved it unchanged (review 2f96eb); only then was this layer recorded, and only after it was the producer edited. The old value is revision 14's approved new value.

amendments.old: Open ONE fresh visible sibling beside you and hand it a first task. Rail follows THIS agent's process context: inside herdr (HERDR_ENV=1), request a NEW UNFOCUSED TAB in your workspace: pi/claude-code via agent start, pi-durable via one native layout request; otherwise use the operator's tmux with all six backends (pi, claude-code, copilot, omp, codex, pi-durable). No fallback: incomplete herdr context rejects by name, never opens unseen tmux. The sibling is asked to call back before its task with the launch nonce; match it and take its garden id from the callback sender envelope. Returns a LAUNCH receipt (owner coordinates + nonce), NOT proof of runtime start, first turn or task delivery. Coordinates are a VIEW, never an address; herdr tab/pane ids can change. Nothing polls. EXISTING citizens: entwurf_v2; facts: entwurf_peers. Model REQUIRED, passed to runtime CLI: provider/model for pi; id/alias for Claude Code; provider/<exact catalog model id> for pi-durable; pattern for the rest. On tmux, copilot/omp/codex/pi-durable refuse BEFORE window creation if birth, MCP, receive or visible-identity units are absent; pi-durable also refuses installed-carrier/exact-SDK failures; codex needs the operator-owned app-server socket Entwurf never starts. In herdr, copilot/omp/codex reject first; pi-durable runs the same unit/carrier/SDK preflight before layout. Optional placement.tmuxSession is TMUX ONLY: ONE EXISTING session, always wins. Omitted, seat follows CALLER, not opened backend: a CODEX CALLER opens beside its TUI pane, others in their own session. Missing session: tmux-session-missing, NOTHING created. Herdr refuses placement by name. No secrets in task: model/task argv are visible to same-user processes.
